game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Sherpa Bridge, a bridge of fixed ropes: the ice axe ranger must handle yetis while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Phrase Slicer: Slice strings to cut messages into exactly the needed pieces.
theme: Frost Peaks – Sherpa Bridge: a bridge of fixed ropes
core_gameplay_loop: In Sherpa Bridge, repeat each round: Slice strings to cut messages into exactly the needed pieces. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the phrase_ok value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the supply cache using at most 16 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The supply cache reached with actions_used <= 16.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 16 before the supply cache is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 5 (applied tier): Phrase Slicer
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Phrase Slicer' (Week 8 slot 2), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Sherpa Bridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how phrase_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yetis in Sherpa Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The supply cache reached with actions_used <= 16.
